title: Login page: the SSO labels of LoginForm (ssoOnlyDescription, usePasswordText, backToSsoText, ssoButton) are passed by neither host and have no bundle keys, so an SSO login reads English on a zh-CN console
body:
Filing gate ①: a user-visible i18n defect with a named landing point. **reach:** a public entry, `apps/console` `/login` in a zh-CN browser context, measured live in Chromium. **Family:** the labels-that-never-reach-`LoginForm` class that objectui#10900 closed for `socialButton` / `orText`. This is its second occurrence, so this card covers the whole family with an enumeration pin rather than one label.

**Reader who acts:** objectui triage. The landing is the `labels` each host passes to `@object-ui/auth`'s `LoginForm`:
- `apps/console/src/pages/auth/LoginPage.tsx` (the `labels={{…}}` block, lines 577–613 on `main` `2dbe5f5`);
- `packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/LoginPage.tsx`, the exported `DefaultLoginPage` (lines 142–158);
- the `auth.login.*` keys in the ten `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` bundles.

Filed by `domain:ui` seat 3 (`session_01Vk15bz8xHtKGUfXfCm16h4`) from the os-dev report on objectui#12682 (PR #12761). That PR does not change this. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens
On a zh-CN console, with `GET /api/v1/auth/config` answering `features.ssoEnforced: true` and one OIDC provider, `/login` shows the card in Chinese (欢迎回来 / 登录后继续你的工作 / 使用 Acme IdP 继续 / 本地开发实例). Two lines stay English:
- "Sign in with your organization's single sign-on" (`ssoOnlyDescription`);
- the break-glass link "Use a password instead" (`usePasswordText`).

## Measured
- Backend: objectstack `66d456d01` `examples/app-crm`, `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`. The console was objectui `claude/issue-12682-sso-login-pending-copy` on Vite; that branch does not touch the hosts' labels.
- Playwright in Chromium, a zh-CN context, with `GET /api/v1/auth/config` routed to the backend's own answer plus `features.ssoEnforced: true` and one OIDC provider. No OIDC provider was configured on the server.
- The two English lines above, on the console's `/login`.

## The family, read from source on `main` `2dbe5f5`
`LoginFormLabels` has 27 members. `LoginForm` falls back to an English literal for each one a host leaves unset (e.g. `labels.usePasswordText ?? 'Use a password instead'`, `LoginForm.tsx:305`).

| member | console `LoginPage` | app-shell `DefaultLoginPage` | `en.ts` key |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `ssoOnlyDescription` | not passed | not passed | none |
| `usePasswordText` | not passed | not passed | none |
| `backToSsoText` | not passed | not passed | none |
| `ssoButton` | not passed | not passed | none |
| `emailOrPhoneLabel`, `emailOrPhonePlaceholder`, `phoneLabel`, `phonePlaceholder`, `otpCodeLabel`, `otpCodePlaceholder`, `sendOtpButton`, `resendOtpCountdownText`, `usePhoneOtpText`, `usePasswordSignInText` | passed | not passed | present |

- The first four rows are untranslatable today on either host: neither passes them, and no bundle has a key for them. The first two were measured live (above); `backToSsoText` and `ssoButton` are read from code only.
- The last row is `DefaultLoginPage` only: the keys exist and the console passes them, but the exported page does not. It is read from code, not measured.

## Expected
- Every `LoginFormLabels` member is translated on both hosts. That takes `auth.login.*` keys in all ten bundles for the four SSO members, and both hosts passing every member.
- An enumeration pin over the `LoginFormLabels` members asserts that each host passes each one, so the next member added to the interface cannot be missed silently, as these were.

**Dedupe** (open and closed):
- every objectui `domain:ui` card (2433 rows), grepped for `ssoOnlyDescription|usePasswordText|backToSsoText|ssoButton`, `Use a password instead|Back to single sign-on|Sign in with SSO` and `single sign-on`: only objectui#12682, which is the divider and pending-caption card, not translation;
- the newest 64 objectui issues (to #12759), the same patterns: only #12682;
- the family's earlier card objectui#10900 is closed `completed` for `socialButton` / `orText`;
- positive control on the same 2433-row list: `setup`, 111 hits.

Dedupe words: SSO-only login copy untranslated; ssoOnlyDescription usePasswordText backToSsoText ssoButton not passed; break-glass link English zh-CN; DefaultLoginPage labels phone OTP.
